svg.title: Zane Wang — building tools that make AI coding agents more reliable
svg.desc: A pixel-art sunset over a city drawn from the past year of Zane's GitHub contributions: one building per week, one window per day, lit on the 298 days he contributed, and a gold pennant over each week in which one of his pull requests was merged upstream. Below the city: 12 PRs merged into 10 upstream projects between Apr – Aug 2026, namely axum, SQLx, AnyIO, goose, Fastify, Zod, TanStack Query, Tenacity, Feast and Claude HUD (three), 10 bug fixes and 2 small features, each merged by that project's maintainers. His production background covers multimodal evaluation and data systems; his current public focus is tools for reliable AI coding agents: claudemem, handoff and dev-orchestrator.

g.text: building tools that make AI coding agents more reliable
claudemem for memory · handoff for delegation · dev-orchestrator for verification
↑ my last year on GitHub: a building per week, a lit window for each of the 298 days I contributed
in Rust, Python, TypeScript and JavaScript,
each merged by that project's maintainers
